videos.description: Who has the best offense in the NFL heading into Week 9? Sports Illustrated's Conor Orr joins fantasy football expert Michael Fabiano for another edition of Fantasy with Fabs, breaking down the NFL's top five rushing and passing offenses after Week 8.  The guys discuss the San Francisco 49ers' explosive rushing attack, the Chicago Bears' rise behind Caleb Williams, the Kansas City Chiefs' struggles, and what it all means for fantasy football.  Plus, Fabs breaks down his biggest fantasy disappointments and surprises, including Justin Jefferson, Jaylen Waddle, Jared Goff, Ollie Gordon, Malik Nabers and more.

videos.title: Stade de France: A Legendary Stadium Gets Ready for the NFL | Stadium Wonders
videos.creator: andrew.kristy
videos.description: Built for the 1998 World Cup and the site of France’s unforgettable victory over Brazil, Stade de France has hosted Rugby World Cup finals, Champions League finals and the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Now, it’s preparing for another milestone: France’s first NFL regular-season game.  Ahead of Steelers vs. Saints, Sports Illustrated’s Stadium Wonders tours the iconic venue, explores its storied history and goes behind the scenes to see what it takes to get Stade de France ready for the NFL.

videos.title: Week 7 Fantasy Football Start ’Em, Sit ’Em: Best and Worst Matchups
videos.creator: doug-v
videos.description: With four NFL teams on bye and injuries continuing to shake up fantasy football rosters, making the right lineup decisions in Week 7 is more important than ever.  Sports Illustrated fantasy expert Michael Fabiano returns with his latest Start ’Em, Sit ’Em picks, highlighting favorable matchups, potential disappointments and under-the-radar streaming options at every position.  Jordan Love and C.J. Stroud headline his preferred quarterback plays, while Patrick Mahomes and Sam Darnold face difficult matchups. At tight end, Tucker Kraft draws an especially favorable matchup against Detroit, but Travis Kelce and Mark Andrews come with concerns.  Fabiano also breaks down his favorite running backs and wide receivers, including Kyren Williams, Bucky Irving, Matthew Golden and Jameson Williams, while identifying several players fantasy managers should consider leaving on the bench.

videos.title: Darian Mensah on Miami Transfer, NFL Goals & Hurricanes’ Loaded Offense | Sports Illustrated
videos.creator: genogonnello
videos.description:
Sports Illustrated staff writer Bryan Fischer sits down with Miami quarterback Darian Mensah at ACC media days in Charlotte in July 2026.

Mensah discusses his decision to transfer to Miami, the Hurricanes’ talented offensive weapons and his early chemistry with Malachi Toney and Mark Fletcher Jr. He also explains how offensive coordinator Shannon Dawson is tailoring the system to his strengths, why Miami can help prepare him for the NFL, what it is like playing for Mario Cristobal and his approach to handling expectations entering the 2026 season.
